# UIKeybindComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Key field of a script UI: the player presses a key or a key combination, and the callback gets it.

## Methods

### single {#single}

::: member

Accepts only one key instead of a combination.

**Returns** [`UIKeybindComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIKeybindComponent) — this key field

:::

### mouse {#mouse}

::: member

Accepts mouse buttons too.

**Returns** [`UIKeybindComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIKeybindComponent) — this key field

:::

### escape {#escape}

::: member

Lets the player choose Escape as a key; by default Escape clears the keys.

**Returns** [`UIKeybindComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIKeybindComponent) — this key field

:::

### keyCombo {#keycombo}

::: member

Shows a key combination in the field without calling the callback.

```js
ui.keybind(function (keys) {
    c.send("Chosen: " + keys);
}).keyCombo("Jump", 32); // GLFW code of Space
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | name of the combination |
| `keys` | `int[]` | GLFW key codes, main key first |

**Returns** [`UIKeybindComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIKeybindComponent) — this key field

:::
